WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, login_state, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date, w.login_state, f.member_key, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, l.login_state, (l.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS has_member,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct, SUM(l.net_amount) AS net
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4;

SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.login_state, (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS order_has_member,
       (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_has_member,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
       MIN(d.calendar_date) AS min_date, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS max_date
FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key AND s.store_id = 900
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4;

SELECT 'dup_web_order_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS v FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line_web', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_w_orders_missing', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_nonweb_store_with_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'order_member_but_guest', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE login_state='guest' AND member_key IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'loggedin_no_member_on_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE login_state='logged_in' AND member_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'line_member_differs_from_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.member_key<>o.member_key
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivered_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL;

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date, w.order_member_key, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS web_net_sales_before_returns,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_web_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS control_web_before_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
